scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/server.mjs && bun build-manifest.ts
scripts.watch: bun build-manifest.ts && bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/server.mjs --watch
scripts.package: rm -rf release && mkdir release && tar --format=ustar --sort=name --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mtime=@0 -cf release/aphelion-plugin.tar -C dist .
